unit_note: USD millions. Table 5 uses dots for no transactions and (**) for amounts below $500,000 in absolute value. Both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. The Rural Electrification and Telecommunications Fund shows (**) for September applicable receipts. The Food and Nutrition Service subtotal includes the four printed program lines, including the WIC label that wraps across two lines.
